description: This file implements a React component for a manual validation and editing page within a Next.js frontend. It allows users to review and modify a persona data object across multiple fields, such as profile summary, skills, career goals, work preferences, strengths, and experience overview. The component manages state for the persona, tracks unsaved changes, provides UI elements for editing and validation, and includes navigation to a subsequent page.

methods.name: handleFieldChange
methods.description: Updates the specified field in the persona data state and marks the form as having unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleAddSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the skills array within the persona data, after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: handleRemoveSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the skills list by index.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Simulates saving changes by resetting the unsaved changes flag.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Confirms the persona if there are no unsaved changes; otherwise prompts the user to save.

methods.name: calculateCompletion
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of completed fields based on current persona data.
